A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same SOAR research and contain readable main text, equations, figures, tables and Appendices A-I. The complete material supports reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original ARC experiments, including sampling/refinement ablations, iterative self-improvement, test-time training and model ensembling (Section 4 and appendices).

after.justification: v2 retains these original experiments, including the 52.00% ensemble ARC-test result and supplementary scaling and joint-training analyses.

M1.justification: Sampling, REX refinement, hindsight relabeling, finetuning and test-time adaptation are unchanged. The removed main-text Algorithm 1 duplicates the pseudocode retained in Appendix D.5, numbered Algorithm 3 in v2.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same ARC coverage: 400 training tasks and 400 public test tasks, including the same test-time adaptation scenarios. No dataset, domain or task coverage is added or removed.

E2.justification: Comparator membership in Table 1 and Appendix Table 6 is unchanged. CodeIt receives more discussion in v2, but its 15.00% comparison entry already appears in v1.

E3.justification: The data split, 3k sampling plus 3k refinement budget, model configurations, accuracy metric and training schedules are unchanged. Appendix B retains the same FLOP-matched comparison.

E4.justification: Both retain the data-selection and joint-training ablations, scaling and ensembling analyses, solution-diversity study, and hybrid-program error analysis. The solution examples and refinement histories in Appendices H-I also match.

E5.justification: Both retain the same point accuracies and performance curves. Neither reports repeated-run or seed counts, confidence intervals or significance tests, and v2 adds no uncertainty-reporting procedure.

E6.justification: Results in Tables 1-7 and Figures 2-10 are unchanged, including 52.00% ensemble ARC-test accuracy and 57.25% oracle accuracy. No numerical results or qualitative findings are added or removed.

T1.justification: The problem definitions, sampling/refinement formulations, learning objectives and Appendix B cost calculations are unchanged. Removing duplicate pseudocode and renumbering algorithms do not change mathematical content.

C1.justification: The introduction refines contribution framing by explicitly presenting SOAR as extending Butt et al.'s self-improvement paradigm through Python synthesis, execution-feedback refinement, larger models and combined test-time training/search. The abstract and central empirical claims remain unchanged.

C2.justification: Interpretations of joint-training synergy, model complementarity and solution diversity are unchanged. The limitations concerning ARC-only evaluation, computational cost, diminishing gains and hybrid-program generalization remain in Section 5 and Appendix F.

D1.justification: Implementation settings, hardware, data processing, inference details, prompts and code-access statements are unchanged. Appendix D.5 preserves the complete algorithm removed from the main text, so no unique technical information is lost.

R1.justification: Sections 1-2 explicitly identify CodeIt as the closest predecessor. v1's brief online-RL/DSL description becomes an explanation of its expert-iteration loop and how SOAR adapts and extends it. The bibliography contains the same works.

P1.justification: Localized additions and rewrites in the introduction and related work clarify the CodeIt relationship. The duplicate main-text algorithm is omitted; section order and appendix organization remain intact.

P2.justification: The duplicate main-text algorithm display is removed, its appendix copy remains, and algorithm numbers and references are updated. Tables and figures shift with text reflow, but their designs, graphical content and captions are unchanged.

improvement.justification: v2 gives more explicit attribution to CodeIt and explains SOAR's distinguishing contributions, making novelty easier to assess. Removing duplicate pseudocode reduces redundancy while preserving Appendix D.5. These are limited improvements in positioning and presentation; the method, empirical evidence and limitations remain unchanged.
